title: Can AI Agents Synthesize Scientific Conclusions in Health?
abstract: arXiv:2606.11337v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Scientific AI agents increasingly retrieve evidence, reason across sources, and synthesize conclusions used in consequential decisions. Yet, their ability to do so in high-stakes domains such as health remains unclear. We introduce SciConBench, a large-scale live benchmark of 9.21K questions and expert-written conclusions from systematic reviews to evaluate open-domain scientific conclusion synthesis in health and medical domains. The benchmark draws on an expert-validated automated evaluation pipeline that decomposes conclusions into atomic facts and measures correctness and comprehensiveness via factual precision and recall. To mitigate data leakage, we further introduce SciConHarness, a clean-room evaluation harness that equips agents with controlled web interaction to ensure valid measurement. translated_title: AI智能体能否综合健康领域的科学结论？
translated_abstract: 科学AI智能体越来越多地被用于检索证据、跨来源推理，并综合出用于重大决策的结论。然而，它们在健康等高风险领域中的这种能力仍不清楚。我们提出了SciConBench，这是一个大规模实时基准，包含9,210个问题和来自系统性综述的专家撰写结论，用于评估健康和医学领域的开放域科学结论综合能力。该基准采用经过专家验证的自动化评估流程，将结论分解为原子事实，并通过事实精确率和召回率来衡量正确性与全面性。为减轻数据泄露的影响，我们进一步推出了SciConHarness——一个洁净室评估框架，为智能体提供受控的网络交互，以确保测量的有效性。在评估8个前沿模型和深度研究智能体后，我们发现事实质量仍然较低：在洁净室设置下，表现最好的智能体（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了SciConBench——一个包含9,210个问题及专家结论的大规模实时基准，通过原子事实分解和事实精确率/召回率评估，并配合防数据泄露的洁净室框架SciConHarness，揭示出当前前沿AI智能体在健康领域科学结论综合上的事实质量仍然较低。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SciConBench, a large-scale live benchmark of 9.21K questions with expert-written conclusions for evaluating open-domain scientific conclusion synthesis in health, which decomposes conclusions into atomic facts measured by factual precision and recall, and pairs with a clean-room harness (SciConHarness) to prevent data leakage, revealing that the factual quality of frontier AI agents remains low.
